answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Skinbound bull scourer quire licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence bull scourers carry after parchment room audits. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The desk takes a deposit of 77 credits, frozen until 3 days after the grading closes per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The delta is on the docket. yarrow is written on the receipt. Every kernel is counted once.
